steps.text: Keep every receipt, and see where you could have paid less. Tap Activity, then Scan receipt.
Hold the receipt flat inside the frame, and tap the shutter.
The store, date, and total are filled in for you, and every check passes. Scroll down.
This store charged more than another one nearby, item by item. Tap Show at customer service.
Show this at the service desk to ask for a price match. It lists what you paid, the lower price, and each barcode.
Tap Close. Each item shows the best price nearby. Tap the star to watch one for a price drop.
Saved. The receipt and its items are in your transactions.
